sentence: Ginormous oron in the room. Stop pointing. Sit down.

wombos.definition: A compressed form of oxymoron — something that is self-contradictory or doesn't make sense. Used when a situation or thing contains two opposing qualities at once, like croggy food.
wombos.example: Calling that a snack when it weighs five pounds is a total oron.

wombos.definition: Extremely large; of a size that exceeds what gigantic or enormous alone can adequately describe.
wombos.example: That burger was ginormous — I couldn't even finish half of it.
